original_reference_rights: Underlying publications retain their own rights; no publisher text or table is redistributed.
admission_rule: Every row remains unavailable to Henry correlation and reference-point dispatch until its required evidence is qualified.
uncertainty_and_range_rule: No candidate uncertainty interval or finite validity range is inferred from compilation precision or source spread.

rows.name: MDEA
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies neutral N-methyldiethanolamine; aqueous absorption also contains protonated MDEA and acid-gas reaction products.
rows.definition_assessment: Compiled values include measured or derived dilute-VLE, VP/AS, and QSPR entries; they do not by themselves qualify an intrinsic neutral-species constant for NeqSim's calibrated reactive models.
rows.required_evidence: Joint Henry/reaction-standard-state qualification with primary VLE conditions, uncertainty, finite range, and unchanged Desmukh-Mather or Kent-Eisenberg benchmarks.

rows.name: MEA
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies neutral monoethanolamine; aqueous absorption also contains protonated MEA and carbamate/bicarbonate reaction products.
rows.definition_assessment: Compiled rows include measured, extrapolated, and calculated values from amine-volatility and VLE sources; their portable intrinsic definition is not yet established.
rows.required_evidence: Joint Henry/reaction-standard-state qualification with primary VLE conditions, uncertainty, finite range, and unchanged reactive-absorption benchmarks.

rows.name: Piperazine
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies neutral piperazine; aqueous absorption also contains one- and two-protonated species and carbamate products.
rows.definition_assessment: Measured and thermodynamic source rows are leads, but neutral-species versus total reactive uptake and transferable conditions remain unqualified.
rows.required_evidence: Joint Henry/reaction-standard-state qualification with primary data, speciation convention, uncertainty, finite range, and unchanged reactive VLE benchmarks.

rows.name: acetic acid
rows.source_types: ? C L M Q T V X
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies neutral acetic acid; aqueous total concentration may include acetate.
rows.definition_assessment: The compilation mixes reviews, measurements, VP/AS, calculations, citations, and estimates; intrinsic neutral acid versus pH-dependent total uptake is not uniformly established.
rows.required_evidence: Primary-source neutral-species definition, pH, ionic strength, pressure basis, uncertainty, range, and coupled dissociation validation.

rows.name: formic acid
rows.source_types: ? C L M Q T V X
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies neutral formic acid; aqueous total concentration may include formate.
rows.definition_assessment: The compilation mixes source types and does not provide one repository-qualified intrinsic definition across pH and temperature.
rows.required_evidence: Primary-source neutral-species definition, pH, ionic strength, pressure basis, uncertainty, range, and coupled dissociation validation.

rows.name: ammonia
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies NH3; aqueous analytical concentration may include NH4+.
rows.definition_assessment: Review, measured, calculated, and unavailable-original rows are research leads; intrinsic NH3 versus protonated total uptake must be separated.
rows.required_evidence: Primary-source NH3 convention, pH, ionic strength, pressure basis, uncertainty, range, and unchanged ammonia reaction-equilibrium benchmarks.

rows.name: HNO2
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies neutral nitrous acid; aqueous total concentration may include nitrite and coupled nitrogen oxides.
rows.definition_assessment: Review, measured, and thermodynamic entries do not alone separate intrinsic HNO2 from reaction/speciation effects.
rows.required_evidence: Primary-source species definition, pH, pressure, reaction time, uncertainty, range, and coupled nitrogen-oxide equilibrium validation.

rows.name: HCN
rows.source_types: ? L M Q R T X
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies neutral HCN; aqueous total concentration may include cyanide.
rows.definition_assessment: The compilation contains several source classes; intrinsic HCN versus dissociated total uptake is not yet qualified for NeqSim.
rows.required_evidence: Primary-source species definition, pH, ionic strength, pressure basis, uncertainty, range, and coupled dissociation validation.

rows.name: chlorine
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies molecular Cl2; aqueous uptake can include HOCl and chloride species.
rows.definition_assessment: Sander notes that prominent recommended data are effective ([Cl2]+[HOCl])/p(Cl2) at 101325 Pa, not an infinite-dilution intrinsic Cl2 constant.
rows.required_evidence: Species-resolved infinite-dilution Cl2 data, hydrolysis equilibrium, pressure/range/uncertainty, and validation of the coupled aqueous reaction model.

rows.name: SO2
rows.source_types: ? C L M Q T V X
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies molecular SO2; aqueous uptake couples hydrated sulfur dioxide, bisulfite, and sulfite.
rows.definition_assessment: The compilation contains local slopes and several source types, but a portable intrinsic SO2 definition must be reconciled with acid-base speciation.
rows.required_evidence: Primary-source species convention, pH/ionic strength, pressure, uncertainty, finite range, and unchanged sulfite-equilibrium benchmarks.

rows.name: NO2
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies NO2; gas and aqueous behavior couples dimerization and oxyacid chemistry.
rows.definition_assessment: Literature and measured constants are leads, but NO2/N2O4 partitioning and reactive aqueous uptake are not separated for this model.
rows.required_evidence: Species-resolved gas dimerization and aqueous-reaction basis, pressure, time scale, uncertainty/range, and independent validation.

rows.name: N2O3
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies N2O3; the cited measurements concern coupled nitrogen-oxide transport and nitrous-acid solutions.
rows.definition_assessment: The literature and measured entries differ materially and are embedded in reaction-equilibrium studies.
rows.required_evidence: Species-resolved equilibrium/kinetics, pressure, time scale, uncertainty/range, and independent validation of the coupled nitrogen-oxide system.

rows.name: N2O4
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies N2O4; gas-phase NO2/N2O4 equilibrium and aqueous reaction prevent an unqualified one-species transfer.
rows.definition_assessment: Literature and measured entries are research leads but do not isolate a model-portable N2O4 constant.
rows.required_evidence: Species-resolved dimerization and aqueous-reaction basis, pressure, time scale, uncertainty/range, and independent validation.

rows.name: CH2O
rows.source_types: ? C L M Q T V X
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies formaldehyde monomer; aqueous uptake rapidly couples hydration to methylene glycol.
rows.definition_assessment: The compilation spans many source classes; monomeric intrinsic partitioning versus total hydrated formaldehyde is not yet qualified.
rows.required_evidence: Primary-source monomer definition, hydration equilibrium/time scale, pH, pressure, uncertainty/range, and independent validation.

rows.name: C2H4O
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies oxirane (ethylene oxide); aqueous measurements can be affected by hydrolysis and reaction time.
rows.definition_assessment: A measured temperature-dependent row and VP/AS values are promising, but portable intrinsic conditions, uncertainty, and reaction controls remain unqualified.
rows.required_evidence: Primary experimental conditions, reaction-time and pH controls, pressure, uncertainty/range, and independent validation before any local expression.

rows.name: H2O2
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies neutral hydrogen peroxide; uptake evidence can depend on pH, decomposition, and experimental handling.
rows.definition_assessment: Multiple review and measured rows broadly agree, making this a strong lead, but the selected primary range, pressure, uncertainty, and stability controls remain unqualified.
rows.required_evidence: Primary experimental data with pH/decomposition controls, pressure, uncertainty/range, and independent validation before any local expression.

rows.name: MEG
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies ethylene glycol as a solute in water; NeqSim also uses MEG as a bulk mixed-solvent component.
rows.definition_assessment: Compiled review, measured, and VP/AS values span orders of magnitude, so no single portable point or slope is qualified.
rows.required_evidence: Selective primary-source review plus mixed-solvent validation; do not dispatch a pure-water infinite-dilution constant into glycol solvent models.

rows.name: MEGPVTsim18
rows.identity_basis: Exact-CAS NeqSim alias of MEG; it supplies no independent source identity or measurement.
rows.definition_assessment: It inherits the same unresolved source spread and mixed-solvent boundary as MEG.
rows.required_evidence: Qualify MEG once against primary data and mixed-solvent controls, then prove exact alias identity before reuse.

rows.name: MEGPVTsim19
rows.identity_basis: Exact-CAS NeqSim alias of MEG; it supplies no independent source identity or measurement.
rows.definition_assessment: It inherits the same unresolved source spread and mixed-solvent boundary as MEG.
rows.required_evidence: Qualify MEG once against primary data and mixed-solvent controls, then prove exact alias identity before reuse.

rows.name: PG
rows.identity_basis: Exact CAS identifies 1,2-propanediol as a solute in water; NeqSim also uses PG as a bulk mixed-solvent component.
rows.definition_assessment: Review and VP/AS entries differ materially and do not qualify a mixed-solvent implementation.
rows.required_evidence: Selective primary-source review plus mixed-solvent validation; do not dispatch a pure-water infinite-dilution constant into glycol solvent models.

rows.name: para-hydrogen
rows.source_types: ? L M Q R T V
rows.identity_basis: NeqSim's name is spin-isomer-specific, but CAS 1333-74-0 and the Sander record identify ordinary H2 rather than a para fraction.
rows.definition_assessment: The ordinary-hydrogen literature cannot establish a para-hydrogen-specific aqueous constant or conversion state.
rows.required_evidence: Spin-isomer-specific aqueous data, para fraction, conversion-equilibrium model, uncertainty/range, and independent validation.

rows.name: ortho-hydrogen
rows.source_types: ? L M Q R T V
rows.identity_basis: NeqSim's name is spin-isomer-specific, but CAS 1333-74-0 and the Sander record identify ordinary H2 rather than an ortho fraction.
rows.definition_assessment: The ordinary-hydrogen literature cannot establish an ortho-hydrogen-specific aqueous constant or conversion state.
rows.required_evidence: Spin-isomer-specific aqueous data, ortho fraction, conversion-equilibrium model, uncertainty/range, and independent validation.
